subject: literacy
concept: Supporting a claim with at least one real reason
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student matches reason cards to the claim they best support
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies which of several sentences is a reason versus just a restatement of the claim
exercise.abstract: Student writes a claim plus one supporting reason

misconception_flags: restates the claim instead of giving an actual reason

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
